findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Not done. Close marks a named test `not checked` when its default test picker decides to run no tests. `fasttest.py:397-405` returns before starting pytest when the selection is too large or no related tests are selected. With no results header, this branch reaches `review.py:670-671` and publishes `not checked`, although Close knows it ran no test. The Done-when rule requires `not run`; the new no-tests test covers a documentation-only skip, not these normal picker paths.
